facts.title: Bundui: Tailwind CSS & shadcn/ui components, UI blocks, examples and more.
facts.description: Tailwind is a carefully curated collection of 200+ handcrafted UI components built with CSS, React, and shadcn/ui.

research.name: Bundui
research.note: Tailwind and shadcn/ui components, marketing and e-commerce blocks, and a few Motion text effects.
unverified: The component source is public at https://github.com/bundui/components (MIT, 407 stars, last commit 2025-10-04); the candidate should be researched as that repository instead of the site.
Pricing free is inferred from the block pages showing no purchase or unlock text; the site also links a separate paid Shadcn UI Kit.
